rationale: Stiven's work on AI-powered surgical navigation at Braillic sits at the intersection of computer vision, ML infrastructure, and embedded systems—areas where John has deep operational and technical expertise across cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and systems architecture. As Stiven scales toward FDA approval and needs engineering talent and infrastructure decisions, John's background in technical operations, cloud-native systems, and community building offers both tactical know-how and network value.
intro_message: Stiven Ding, meet John Komarnicki — his experience scaling cloud infrastructure and ML systems could help you think through the technical and operational side of Braillic's growth phase.
